For residential care centres

A dental visit that comes to your centre.

For many residents, getting to a dental practice takes more effort than the appointment itself. Global Smile Care brings dentists and assistants to your centre for checkups and straightforward treatment.

Why care on site

Keep the visit close to everyday life.

↗

Less to organise around travel

Residents can be seen at the centre, reducing the need to arrange a journey for a routine dental visit.

↗

A familiar setting for residents

Appointments happen where residents already spend their day, with the centre team close by.

↗

One plan with your team

We discuss timing and practical arrangements with the people who know the centre's routine.

Working together

A visit starts with a conversation.

No two centres work in quite the same way. We first learn what your residents need and how a visit could fit your day.

01

Tell us about your centre

Share your location, the residents you hope to support, and any practical questions.

02

Agree on the arrangement

We discuss suitable visit days, timing, and what care can be provided on site.

03

Welcome the dental team

Our dentists and assistants visit the centre for the agreed examinations and appropriate treatment.

We confirm the practical details with your team before visits begin.

A clear scope of care

Know what to expect on site.

Our mobile team visits for dental examinations and simple treatments. What is appropriate depends on each resident's needs and the facilities available at your centre.

Examine

Check residents' oral health and identify concerns that need attention.

Treat

Provide straightforward care when it is suitable for an on-site visit.

Plan ahead

Discuss what follows when a resident needs care beyond an on-site visit.
